title: Language | the header EN/AR switch is not saved to the account; Settings › Locale still says English
env: staging-crm.taviportal.com, build index-De3hTVb3.js (test user 2, Arabic) vs Zoho CRM org943261092 (read-only)

panels.caption: TAVI: after switching to Arabic in the header, Settings › Personal › Locale.
Zoho: Personal Settings › Locale Information (language is an account setting).

rows: Account setting under Personal Settings › Locale Information

Header switch only sets the browser (localStorage); no request to the server; account value stays 'en' and the Locale page shows English while the UI is Arabic. Saving on the Locale page does store it per user (PUT /settings/value, scope User).
